subject: Get Help With Graduate School Applications! 🎓
body:
Free Events to help you apply!

The UAlbany Graduate School <https://www.albany.edu/graduate> warmly invites you to attend our free Graduate School Preparation Academy workshops and webinars designed to assist you with the graduate school (master's and PhD) application process. 

                  Topics include: 

September 30th: Why Graduate School? 
October 1st: How to Choose a Graduate Program
October 5th: Applying to Graduate School
October 6th: Writing Your Personal Statement 
October 7th: Finding Funding
                                   
Our in-person events take place at 12:30PM 
and online/Zoom events are at 6:30PM.  
All dates and times are in US Eastern (New York) Time. 
 
Click below to register for these sessions! 
See Grad Prep Events & REgister <https://admissions.albany.edu/portal/GradSchoolPrepAcademy>


                  We hope to see you soon! 

                  Chloe Glenn, MSW
                  Assistant Director of Graduate Recruitment 
                  The Graduate School
                  University at Albany
                  +1 518-442-3980


            University at Albany | 1400 Washington Avenue | Albany, New York 12222 | albany.edu/graduate
